title.zh: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二
title.raw: 卷二 本紀第二 太祖二 Volume 2 Annals 2: Taizu 2

sentences.zh: 太祖二

translations.literal: Taizu II.
translations.idiomatic: Annals of Taizu, continued.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸酉朔，以出師不御殿。

translations.literal: In year three, spring, first month, on guiyou, the new-moon day, because the army had gone forth he did not preside in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianlong year three, on the guiyou new moon in the first month of spring, he withheld court audience while the expedition was in the field.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，王全斌克劍門，斬首萬餘级，禽蜀樞密使王昭遠、澤州節度趙崇韜。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Wang Quanbin captured Jianmen Pass, cut off heads in excess of ten thousand, and captured Shu Grand Councilor Wang Zhaoyuan and Zezhou military commissioner Zhao Chongtao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Wang Quanbin took Jianmen Pass, claiming more than ten thousand heads, and seized Shu Grand Councilor Wang Zhaoyuan and Zezhou commissioner Zhao Chongtao.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔瘗征蜀戰死士卒，被傷者給繒帛。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict ordered burial of soldiers who had died in the campaign against Shu; the wounded were given silk.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he ordered the war dead of the Shu campaign interred and issued silk to the wounded.

sentences.zh: 壬午，全斌取利州。

translations.literal: On renwu, Quanbin took Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Wang Quanbin captured Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，蜀主孟昶降。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Shu ruler Meng Chang surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Shu sovereign Meng Chang submitted.

sentences.zh: 得州四十五、縣一百九十八、户五十三萬四千三十有九。

translations.literal: They obtained forty-five prefectures, one hundred ninety-eight counties, and five hundred thirty-four thousand thirty-nine households.
translations.idiomatic: The conquest brought in forty-five prefectures, one hundred ninety-eight counties, and five hundred thirty-four thousand thirty-nine households.

sentences.zh: 高麗國王遣使來朝獻。

translations.literal: The king of Goryeo sent envoys to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Goryeo dispatched envoys to present tribute at court.

sentences.zh: 戊子，吏部郎中鄧守中坐試吏不當，責本曹員外郎。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Deng Shouzhong, director in the Ministry of Personnel, for improper examination of officials, was demoted to deputy director in the same bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Deng Shouzhong of the Ministry of Personnel was reduced to deputy director for mishandling the officials' examination.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，劉光義取萬、施、開、忠四州，遂州守臣陳愈降。

translations.literal: On guisi, Liu Guangyi took Wan, Shi, Kai, and Zhong prefectures; Suizhou prefect Chen Yu surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Liu Guangyi seized Wan, Shi, Kai, and Zhong, and Suizhou prefect Chen Yu came over.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔撫西川將吏百姓。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict ordered comfort for Western Shu generals, clerks, and common people.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he issued an edict to reassure Western Shu officers, clerks, and the populace.

sentences.zh: 丙申，赦蜀，歸俘獲，除管内逋賦，免夏税及沿徵物色之半。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Shu was granted amnesty, captives were returned, overdue taxes within the circuit were remitted, and half the summer tax and half the goods levied along the transport route were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he pardoned Shu, sent captives home, canceled arrears in the circuit, and halved the summer tax and the levies collected en route.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，南唐、吳越進長春節御衣、金銀器、錦綺以千計。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guimao, Southern Tang and Wuyue presented Longevity Festival imperial robes, gold and silver vessels, and brocades and silks numbering in the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guimao, Southern Tang and Wuyue sent thousands of Longevity Festival robes, gold and silver wares, and silks.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遣皇城使竇思儼迎勞孟昶。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Imperial City commissioner Dou Siyan was dispatched to welcome and console Meng Chang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he sent Imperial City commissioner Dou Siyan to greet and honor Meng Chang on the road.

sentences.zh: 丁未，全州大水。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Quanzhou suffered a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei flooding devastated Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，王全斌殺蜀降兵二萬七千人於成都。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Wang Quanbin killed twenty-seven thousand surrendered Shu troops at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Quanbin massacred twenty-seven thousand surrendered Shu soldiers at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，詔置義倉。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guiyou, an edict ordered the establishment of charity granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou, he decreed the restoration of charity granaries.

sentences.zh: 是月，兩川賊群起，先鋒都指揮使高彥暉死之，詔所在攻討。

translations.literal: That month bandits rose in mass throughout the two Shu circuits; vanguard commander-in-chief Gao Yanhui died fighting them; an edict ordered each locality to attack and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: That month rebellion flared across both Shu circuits; vanguard commander Gao Yanhui fell in action, and the throne ordered every district to hunt the rebels down.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，回鶻遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yisi, the Uighurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi, Uighur envoys arrived with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，職方員外郎李岳坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: On guichou, Li Yue, deputy director in the Bureau of Appointments, for corruption was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Li Yue, deputy director in the Bureau of Appointments, was executed in the market for graft.

sentences.zh: 南唐進賀收蜀銀絹以萬計。

translations.literal: Southern Tang presented congratulatory silver and silk for the conquest of Shu numbering in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang sent tens of thousands in silver and silk to congratulate the court on the fall of Shu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣中使給蜀臣鞍馬、車乘于江陵。

translations.literal: On wuwu, palace envoys were dispatched to give Shu ministers saddles, horses, and carriages at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he sent palace commissioners to Jiangling with saddles, horses, and carriages for the Shu officials.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，募諸軍子弟導五丈河，通皇城為池。

translations.literal: On guihai, sons of the various armies were recruited to channel the Wuzhang River and connect it to the Imperial City as a moat pool.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he drafted soldiers' sons to divert the Wuzhang River and link it to the palace as an inner moat.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未朔，詔還諸道幕職、令錄經引對者，以涉途遠近，差減其選。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinwei, the new-moon day, an edict ordered circuit staff appointees and county magistrates and registrars who had been presented at court to return; according to the distance of the journey, their civil-service examination ranking was reduced by degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon in the fifth month he sent home circuit aides and county magistrates who had already been presented at court, trimming their examination standing according to how far they had traveled.

sentences.zh: 壬申，幸迎春苑宴射。

translations.literal: On renshen, he visited Welcome Spring Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he went to Welcome Spring Garden for a banquet and archery.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣開封尹光義勞孟昶於玉津園。

translations.literal: On yihai, Kaifeng Intendant Guangyi was dispatched to console Meng Chang at Yujin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he sent Kaifeng intendant Liu Guangyi to entertain Meng Chang at Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，見孟昶於崇元殿，宴昶等於大明殿。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he received Meng Chang at Chongyuan Hall and banqueted Chang and the others at Daming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he met Meng Chang in Chongyuan Hall and feasted him and his party in Daming Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賜將士衣服錢帛。

translations.literal: On dinghai, clothing and money-silk were bestowed on officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he rewarded the troops with cloth and cash.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大赦，減死罪一等。

translations.literal: On wuzi, a great amnesty was proclaimed, and death sentences were reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he proclaimed a general amnesty and commuted capital crimes one step.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宴孟昶及其子弟於大明殿。

translations.literal: On renchen, he banqueted Meng Chang and his sons and brothers at Daming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he again feasted Meng Chang and his kin in Daming Hall.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，珍州刺史田景遷內附。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Zhenzhou prefect Tian Jingqian came in allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Zhenzhou prefect Tian Jingqian submitted to the court.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，追封孟昶為楚王。

translations.literal: On renchen, Meng Chang was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he enfeoffed the late Meng Chang as Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，幸教船池，遂幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On dingyou, he visited the Boat-Training Pool, then visited Yujin Garden for a feast with archery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he inspected the Boat-Training Pool, then shot arrows and feasted at Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌朔，詔籍郡國驍勇兵送闕下。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuxu, the new-moon day, an edict ordered registration of valiant troops in every circuit and prefecture for dispatch to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon in the eighth month he ordered the circuits to muster their bravest soldiers and send them to court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，河決陽武縣。

translations.literal: On guimao, the Yellow River broke its banks in Yangwu county.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Yellow River burst through at Yangwu.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔王全斌等廩蜀亡命兵士家。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict ordered Wang Quanbin and others to provision the families of Shu soldiers who had fled as outlaws.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he told Wang Quanbin and his colleagues to supply the households of Shu deserters.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，河溢河陽，壞民居。

translations.literal: On yimao, the river overflowed at Heyang and destroyed commoners' dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao floods at Heyang swept away private homes.

sentences.zh: 戊午，殿直成德鈞坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Cheng Dejun, a palace attendant, for corruption was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu palace attendant Cheng Dejun was executed in the market for taking bribes.

sentences.zh: 己未，鄆州河水溢，沒田。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the river at Yanzhou overflowed and inundated fields.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Yanzhou river rose and drowned the cropland.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，壽星見。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the longevity star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou a longevity star was seen in the sky.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，閱諸道兵，以騎軍為驍雄，步軍為雄武，並隸親軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi, troops from every circuit were reviewed; the cavalry were styled Xiaoxiong, the infantry Xiongwu, and both were placed under the personal armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi, he inspected the provincial armies, renaming the horse units Xiaoxiong and the foot Xiongwu and folding them into the palace guards.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔蜀諸郡各置克寧軍五百人。

translations.literal: On renshen, an edict ordered each Shu prefecture to station five hundred Pacification Army soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he required every Shu commandery to keep five hundred men of the Pacification Army on station.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，河決澶州。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Yellow River broke its banks at Cao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Yellow River breached its dikes in Cao prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸西水磑。

translations.literal: On wuzi, he visited the West Water Mill.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he went out to the West Water Mill.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉朔，大霧。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on dingyou, the new-moon day, there was a great fog.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou new moon in the tenth month a dense fog blanketed the capital.

sentences.zh: 己未，太子中舍王治坐受贓殺人，棄市。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Wang Zhi, a palace aide, for taking bribes and killing a man was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei palace aide Wang Zhi was put to death in the market for bribery and murder.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，濟水溢鄒平。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Ji River overflowed at Zouping.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Ji River flooded Zouping.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，甘州回鶻可汗遣僧獻佛牙、寶器。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, the Ganzhou Uighur qaghan sent a monk presenting a Buddha tooth and precious vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingzi, the Ganzhou Uighur khan sent a monk bearing a Buddha tooth and ritual treasures.

sentences.zh: 乙未，劍州刺史張仁謙坐殺降，貶宋州教練。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Jian prefect Zhang Renqian, for killing those who had surrendered, was demoted to drill instructor at Song prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Jian prefect Zhang Renqian was banished to a training post in Songzhou for slaughtering surrendering troops.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉朔，詔婦為舅姑喪者齊、斬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingyou, the new-moon day, an edict ordered that women mourning parents-in-law observe qi and zhan mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou new moon in the twelfth month he required daughters-in-law to wear full mourning for fathers- and mothers-in-law.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔西川管內監軍、巡檢毋預州縣事。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict ordered that military supervisors and inspectors within the western Sichuan circuit were not to intervene in prefecture and county affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the court decreed that army overseers and circuit inspectors in western Sichuan must keep out of civil prefectural and county business.

sentences.zh: 戊午，甘州回鶻可汗、于闐國王等遣使來朝，進馬千匹、橐駝五百頭、玉五百團、琥珀五百斤。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Gansu Uyghur khan, the king of Khotan, and others sent envoys to court, presenting one thousand horses, five hundred Bactrian camels, five hundred lumps of jade, and five hundred jin of amber.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Khan of the Ganzhou Uyghurs, the King of Khotan, and others came to court with tribute: a thousand horses, five hundred camels, five hundred pieces of jade, and five hundred jin of amber.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月丙子，遣使分詣江陵、鳳翔，賜蜀群臣家錢帛。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on bingzi, envoys were dispatched separately to Jiangling and Fengxiang to grant money and silks to the households of Shu ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on the bingzi day of the first month, the court sent envoys to Jiangling and Fengxiang to bestow money and silks on the families of former Shu officials.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命丁德裕等率兵巡撫西川。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Ding Deyu and others were ordered to lead troops on a pacifying tour of western Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Ding Deyu and others were ordered to lead troops through western Sichuan to restore order.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸迎春苑宴射。

translations.literal: On jichou, the emperor visited Yingchun Garden for a feast and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the emperor went to Yingchun Garden for a banquet and archery contest.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，視皇城役。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guimao, he inspected labor on the Imperial City.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guimao, he inspected work on the Imperial City walls.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，于闐國王遣其子德從來獻。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the king of Khotan sent his son Dezong to come and present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the King of Khotan sent his son Dezong with tribute.

sentences.zh: 安國軍節度使羅彥瓌等敗北漢於靜陽，擒其將鹿英。

translations.literal: Anguo Army military commissioner Luo Yanqiong and others defeated Northern Han at Jingyang and captured their general Lu Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Yanqiong, military commissioner of the Anguo Army, and others routed Northern Han at Jingyang and took their general Lu Ying prisoner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，試下第舉人。

translations.literal: On xinyou, failed candidates of the civil examinations were retested.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court held a supplemental examination for candidates who had failed the regular test.

sentences.zh: 甲子，免西川今年夏稅及諸征之半，田不得耕者盡除之。

translations.literal: On jiazi, western Sichuan's summer tax for this year and half of various levies were remitted; for fields that could not be cultivated, all levies were wholly abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the court remitted western Sichuan's summer tax for the year and cut other levies by half; wherever fields lay untilled, every charge was wiped away.

sentences.zh: 岳州火。

translations.literal: Yuezhou suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: A fire broke out in Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，罷義倉。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guiyou, the righteousness granaries were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou, the court abolished the charity granaries.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，占城國遣使來獻。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Champa sent envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu envoys from Champa arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸未，僧行勤等一百五十七人，各賜錢三萬，游西域。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the monks Xingqin and one hundred fifty-seven others were each granted thirty thousand cash to travel the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the monk Xingqin and a hundred fifty-seven companions were each given thirty thousand cash for a pilgrimage to the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，占城遣使來獻。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on dingyou, Champa sent envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingyou, Champa again sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙午，潭州火。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Tanzhou suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Tanzhou was struck by fire.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷光州貢鷹鷂。

translations.literal: On renzi, the tribute of hawks and falcons from Guangzhou was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the court ended Guangzhou's tribute levy of hawks and falcons.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，契丹天德軍節度使于延超與其子來降。

translations.literal: On disi, the Khitan Tiande Army military commissioner Yu Yanchao came to surrender together with his son.
translations.idiomatic: On disi Yu Yanchao, Khitan military commissioner of the Tiande Army, surrendered with his son.

sentences.zh: 進士李藹坐毀釋氏，辭不遜，黥杖，配沙門島。

translations.literal: Presented scholar Li Ai, for slandering Buddhism and using disrespectful language in his memorial, was tattooed, beaten with the cudgel, and banished to Shamen Island.
translations.idiomatic: The presented scholar Li Ai, having reviled Buddhism and answered the throne insolently, was tattooed, flogged, and sent to Shamen Island.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸燕國長公主第視疾。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the emperor visited the residence of the Princess of Yan to inquire after her illness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the emperor called at the Princess of Yan's house to see how she fared in her illness.

sentences.zh: 五月，南唐賀文明殿成，進銀萬兩。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Southern Tang congratulated the completion of the Hall of Civilization and presented ten thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Southern Tang sent congratulations on the completion of the Hall of Civilization, with ten thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，光祿少卿郭玘坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Vice Director of the Imperial Sacrifices Guo Qi, for corruption, was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Guo Qi, vice director of the Imperial Sacrifices, was beheaded in the marketplace for graft.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，閱蜀法物、圖書。

translations.literal: On yihai, Shu ritual objects and books and maps were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the court inspected the ritual regalia, books, and maps taken from Shu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔蜀郡敢有不省父母疾者罪之。

translations.literal: On dingchou, an edict decreed that in Shu prefectures anyone who dared not attend to parents' illness would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict warned that in the Shu commanderies anyone who failed to nurse sick parents would be punished.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，潭州火。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Tanzhou suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi fire ravaged Tanzhou again.

sentences.zh: 壬午，澶州進麥兩歧至六歧者百六十五本。

translations.literal: On renwu, Cangzhou presented one hundred sixty-five stalks of wheat bearing from two to six ears each.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Cangzhou sent up a hundred sixty-five stalks of wheat with from two to six ears apiece.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，熒惑犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Mars transgressed the Xuanyuan constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Mars crossed the Xuanyuan asterism.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，東阿河溢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiawu, the Dong'e River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiawu, the Dong'e River burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，河決觀城。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Yellow River burst its banks at Guancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Yellow River broke through at Guancheng.

sentences.zh: 月犯心前星。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the anterior star of the Heart constellation.
translations.idiomatic: The moon crossed the leading star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 丙午，澧州刺史白全紹坐縱紀綱規財部內免官。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Li prefecture prefect Bai Quanshao was dismissed from office for allowing his clerks to extort wealth within his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Bai Quanshao, prefect of Li, was removed for letting his staff squeeze money from people under his rule.

sentences.zh: 詔：人臣家不得私養宦者，內侍年三十以上方許養一子，士庶敢有閹童男者不赦。

translations.literal: An edict: ministers' households must not privately keep eunuchs; within the palace service, only those thirty years of age or above might rear one son; commoners who dared keep castrated boys would receive no pardon.
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared that no minister's household might harbor eunuchs privately; inside the palace only men over thirty might adopt a single son; and any commoner who kept a castrated boy would not be spared.

sentences.zh: 己酉，果州貢禾，一莖十三穗。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Guozhou presented grain with one stalk bearing thirteen ears.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Guozhou sent tribute grain: one stalk carried thirteen ears.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，詔：蜀官將吏及姻屬疾者，所在給醫藥錢帛。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingyin, an edict: for Shu officials, soldiers, clerks, and affinal kin who fell ill, wherever they were, medicine, money, and silks were to be supplied.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingyin, the court ordered that any Shu official, soldier, clerk, or relation by marriage who fell sick was to receive medicine, money, and silks wherever he lay.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，西南夷首領董暠等內附。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the southwestern barbarian chieftain Dong Hao and others submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Dong Hao and other chieftains of the southwestern tribes came in to submit.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸造船務，又幸開封尹北園宴射。

translations.literal: On jisi, the emperor visited the shipbuilding office; he also visited the Kaifeng prefect's north garden for a feast and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he inspected the shipyard, then went to the north garden of the Kaifeng prefect for a banquet and archery.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，賜西川行營將士錢帛有差。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the western Sichuan field army officers and soldiers were granted money and silks in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the court rewarded the western Sichuan campaign troops with graded gifts of money and silk.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，罷劍南蜀米麥征。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Shu grain and wheat levies in Jiannan were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the court lifted the Shu grain and wheat taxes in Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 華州旱，免今年租。

translations.literal: Huazhou suffered drought; this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Huazhou was stricken by drought, and its land tax for the year was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 給州縣官奉戶。

translations.literal: Salary households were granted to prefecture and county officials.
translations.idiomatic: The court assigned tax households to support prefectural and county salaries.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，詔除蜀倍息。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingyou, an edict abolished double interest on Shu debts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou, an edict wiped out the doubled interest charged on Shu loans.

sentences.zh: 庚子，水壞高苑縣城。

translations.literal: On gengzi, floodwaters destroyed Gaoyuan county seat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi floods wrecked the walled seat of Gaoyuan county.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔憲臣及吏、刑部官三周歲滿日，即轉授加恩。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict: when censorial officials and officials of the Ministry of Personnel and Ministry of Justice completed three years in post, they were at once transferred and granted favor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict required that censors and officials of Personnel and Justice, once three years in office were up, be rotated promptly and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，樞密直學士馮瓚、綾錦副使李美、殿中侍御史李橶為宰相趙普陷，以贓論死；

translations.literal: On gengxu, Palace Secretariat academician Feng Zan, brocade deputy commissioner Li Mei, and palace censor Li Qi were trapped by Chancellor Zhao Pu on charges of corruption and sentenced to death;
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Feng Zan, academician of the Palace Secretariat, Li Mei, deputy commissioner of brocades, and Li Qi, palace censor, were framed by Chancellor Zhao Pu for graft and condemned to death;

sentences.zh: 會赦，流沙門島，逢恩不還。

translations.literal: An amnesty intervened; they were banished to Shamen Island, but when grace was offered they did not return.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty spared their lives and sent them to Shamen Island instead, yet when mercy called them back they refused to come.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the emperor visited Yujin Garden for a feast and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the emperor feasted and shot at Yujin Garden.

sentences.zh: 京兆府貢野蠶繭。

translations.literal: The Jingzhao metropolitan prefecture presented wild silkworm cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhao sent up cocoons from wild silkworms as tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬子，衡州火。

translations.literal: On renzi, Hengzhou suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi fire broke out in Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，錄囚。

translations.literal: On yimao, prisoners were reviewed in court.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor held a judicial review of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，河決滑州，壞靈河大堤。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Yellow River burst its banks at Huazhou, destroying the great dike at Linghe.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the Yellow River broke through at Huazhou and wrecked the great Linghe embankment.

sentences.zh: 普州兔食稼。

translations.literal: At Puzhou rabbits ate the grain in the fields.
translations.idiomatic: In Puzhou rabbits ravaged the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙丑，河溢入南華縣。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on yichou, the river overflowed into Nanhua county.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yichou, floodwaters poured into Nanhua county.

sentences.zh: 己巳，衡州火。

translations.literal: On jisi, Hengzhou suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi fire broke out in Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔︰民能樹藝、開墾者不加征，令佐能勸來者受賞。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict: commoners who could plant trees and open land for cultivation would not have levies added; magistrates and assistants who could encourage them to come would receive reward.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai an edict promised that farmers who planted orchards or reclaimed waste land would face no new taxes, and that local magistrates who drew settlers to such work would be rewarded.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰朔，水。

translations.literal: On the renchen new-moon day of the ninth month, there was flood.
translations.idiomatic: The renchen new moon in the ninth month brought flooding.

sentences.zh: 虎捷指揮使孫進、龍衛指揮使吳瓌等二十七人，坐黨呂翰亂伏誅，夷進族。

translations.literal: Tiger Swift commander Sun Jin, Dragon Guards commander Wu Gui, and twenty-seven others, for being implicated in Lü Han's rebellion, were executed, and Jin's clan was exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven men, including Tiger Swift commander Sun Jin and Dragon Guards commander Wu Gui, were put to death for ties to Lü Han's mutiny; Sun Jin's kin were wiped out with him.

sentences.zh: 庚子，占城獻馴象。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Champa presented tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Champa sent tame elephants as tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸教船池，遂幸玉津園觀衛士騎射。

translations.literal: On yisi, he visited the Naval Drill Pool, then visited Jade Ford Garden to watch the guardsmen's mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he went to the Naval Drill Pool, then to Jade Ford Garden to watch the guards ride and shoot.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔吳越立禹廟於會稽。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict ordered Wu-Yue to erect a temple to Yu at Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he commanded Wu-Yue to build a temple to Yu the Great at Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉朔，命太常復二舞。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the xinyou new-moon day, he ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to restore the Two Dances.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon of the tenth winter month he ordered the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to revive the two ritual dances.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔諸郡立古帝王陵廟，置戶有差。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict ordered the various prefectures to erect temples at the tombs of ancient emperors and kings, establishing households in graded numbers.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict directed every prefecture to build shrines at the tombs of ancient sovereigns, each assigned a fixed number of caretaker households.

sentences.zh: 己巳，禁吏卒以巡察擾民。

translations.literal: On jisi, it was forbidden for clerks and soldiers on patrol inspection to harass the people.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he banned officers and troops on inspection rounds from troubling the populace.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，妖人張龍兒等二十四人伏誅，夷龍兒、李玉、楊密、聶贇族

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen, sorcerers Zhang Long'er and twenty-three others were executed, and the clans of Long'er, Li Yu, Yang Mi, and Nie Yun were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengchen, twenty-four self-styled wonder-workers led by Zhang Long'er were put to death, and the families of Long'er, Li Yu, Yang Mi, and Nie Yun were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月戊戌，治河堤。

translations.literal: Year five, spring, first month, on wuxu, river dikes were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on wuxu in the first month of spring, work began on the river embankments.

sentences.zh: 丁未，合州漢初縣上青樛木，中有文曰「大連宋」。

translations.literal: On dingwei, a green twisted tree was presented from Hanchu county in Hezhou; within it were characters reading "Great Lian Song."
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Hanchu county in Hezhou reported a green gnarled tree bearing the inscription "Great Lian Song" in its grain.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，王全斌等坐伐蜀黷貨殺降，全斌責崇義軍節度使，崔彥進責昭化軍節度使，王仁贍責右衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Wang Quanbin and others, for plunder and killing surrendered men during the Shu campaign, were punished: Quanbin was demoted to military commissioner of the Chongyi Army, Cui Yanjin to military commissioner of the Zhaohua Army, Wang Renzan to great general of the Right Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Wang Quanbin and others were punished for looting and slaughtering surrendering Shu troops: Quanbin was reduced to commissioner of Chongyi, Cui Yanjin to commissioner of Zhaohua, and Wang Renzan to great general of the Right Guards.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔伐蜀將校有受蜀人錢物者，並即還主。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict: officers of the Shu campaign who had received money and goods from Shu people were to return them at once to their owners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he decreed that any officer of the Shu expedition who had taken gifts from locals must restore them immediately.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，賞伐蜀功，曹彬、劉光義等進爵有差。

translations.literal: On dingsi, rewards were given for merit in the Shu campaign; Cao Bin, Liu Guangyi, and others advanced in noble rank by grades.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court rewarded the conquerors of Shu, promoting Cao Bin, Liu Guangyi, and others in rank according to their merits.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申朔，幸造船務，遂幸城西觀衛士騎射。

translations.literal: Second month, on the gengshen new-moon day, he visited the shipyard, then visited west of the city to watch the guardsmen's mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the second month he inspected the shipyard, then rode west of the city to watch the guards shoot from horseback.

sentences.zh: 甲子，薛居正、呂餘慶並為吏部侍郎，依前參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Xue Juzheng and Lü Yuqing were both made vice directors in the Ministry of Personnel and, as before, participated in governing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Xue Juzheng and Lü Yuqing were appointed vice directors of Personnel and continued as junior grand councilors.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸教船池。

translations.literal: On jichou, he visited the Naval Drill Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he went again to the Naval Drill Pool.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，詔翰林學士、常參官於幕職、州縣及京官內各舉堪任常參官者一人，不當者連坐。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiachen, an edict: Hanlin academicians and regular attendees were each to recommend from among staff officers, prefectural and county officials, and capital officials one person fit to serve as regular attendee; if unfit, there would be joint punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiachen, Hanlin scholars and regular court attendees were told each to nominate one able colleague from the provinces or the capital staff for regular attendance, on pain of shared punishment if the choice proved unworthy.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔諸道舉部內官吏才德優異者。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict ordered the various circuits to recommend officials within their jurisdictions of outstanding talent and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he called on every circuit to recommend its most capable and upright officers.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以普為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，崇矩檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Pu was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, with seal as Fellow of the Secretariat-Chancellery; Chongju was made honorary Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zhao Pu was named Left Vice Director of State Affairs and Vice Director of the Chancellery with full chancellor's powers, while Chongju received the honorary title Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 是日，幸教船池，又幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: That day, he visited the Naval Drill Pool, and again visited Jade Ford Garden for a banquet and archery.
translations.idiomatic: The same day he watched naval drills, then feasted and shot at Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，北漢石盆砦招收指揮使閻章以砦來降。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Northern Han Stone Basin Fort reception commander Yan Zhang brought the fort and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yan Zhang, reception commander of Northern Han's Stone Basin Fort, came over with his garrison.

sentences.zh: 五星聚奎。

translations.literal: The five planets gathered at the Legs mansion.
translations.idiomatic: The five planets converged in the Legs asterism.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙巳，賜京城貧民衣。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, on yisi, clothing was granted to the poor of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month, on yisi, the court clothed the capital's poor.

sentences.zh: 北漢鴻唐砦招收指揮使樊暉以砦來降。

translations.literal: Northern Han Hongtang Fort reception commander Fan Hui brought the fort and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Hui, reception commander of Northern Han's Hongtang Fort, surrendered with his stronghold.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，王溥為太子太傅。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Wang Pu was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Wang Pu was appointed Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on the wuwu new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: A solar eclipse fell on the wuwu new moon of the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸建隆觀，遂幸飛龍院。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he visited Jianlong Abbey, then visited Flying Dragon Court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he called at Jianlong Abbey and then at Flying Dragon Court.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，牂牁順化王子等來獻方物。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Zangge Shunhua king's son and others came to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the prince of Zangge Shunhua and others arrived with regional tribute.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉，禁毀銅佛像。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on dingyou, destroying copper Buddha images was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingyou, he outlawed the melting of bronze Buddha statues.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免水旱災戶今年租。

translations.literal: On jiyou, this year's rent was remitted for households afflicted by flood, drought, or pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he waived the year's land tax for families struck by flood, drought, or plague.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，河溢入衛州城，民溺死者數百。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiashen, the river overflowed into Weizhou city; several hundred commoners drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiashen, floods poured into Weizhou and drowned hundreds of townspeople.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，倉部員外郎陳郾坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renchen, Warehouse Department outer departmental director Chen Yin, for corruption, was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen, Chen Yin of the Warehouse Department was beheaded in the market for graft.

sentences.zh: 甲午，西南蕃順化王子部才等遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Southwestern Barbarians Shunhua king's son Bu Cai and others dispatched envoys to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Bu Cai, son of the southwestern Shunhua king, sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 己酉，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On jiyou, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he hunted on the outskirts.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉朔，工部侍郎毋守素坐居喪娶妾免。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on the yiyou new-moon day, Ministry of Works vice director Wu Shousu, for taking a concubine while in mourning, was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the eleventh month, Wu Shousu of Works was removed for wedding a concubine during his father's mourning.

sentences.zh: 供奉武仁海坐枉殺人棄市。

translations.literal: Palace attendant Wu Renhai, for wrongly killing a man, was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant Wu Renhai was put to death in the market for an unjust killing.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，禁新小鐵鑞等錢、疏惡布帛入粉藥者。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on bingchen, newly minted small iron pots and the like as coin, and coarse, inferior cloth and silk mixed with powder and drugs, were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, he banned debased iron coinage and shoddy textiles dressed with chalk or dye fillers.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，升麟州為建寧軍節度。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Lin Prefecture was promoted to Jianning Army command.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Linzhou was raised to a Jianning Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 趙普以母憂去位，丙子，起復。

translations.literal: Zhao Pu left office on account of his mother's mourning; on bingzi he was recalled to service.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Pu had stepped down for his mother's funeral, but on bingzi the court recalled him to duty.

sentences.zh: 開寶元年春正月甲午，增治京城。

translations.literal: Kaibao year one, spring, first month, on jiawu, the capital was enlarged and administered.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, Kaibao year one, on jiawu, work expanded on fortifying the capital.

sentences.zh: 陝之集津、絳之垣曲、懷之武陟飢，振之。

translations.literal: Jijin in Shan, Yuanqu in Jiang, and Wuzhi in Huai suffered famine; they were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck Jijin in Shaan, Yuanqu in Jiang, and Wuzhi in Huai, and the court sent relief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，北漢偏城砦招收指揮使任恩等來降。

translations.literal: On jihai, Northern Han Piancheng Fort reception commander Ren En and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Ren En, reception commander of Northern Han's Piancheng Fort, and others defected.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，班縣令、尉捕盜令。

translations.literal: Third month, on gengyin, the ordinance on county magistrates and aides capturing bandits was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, he issued regulations binding county magistrates and constables to hunt down robbers.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On guisi, he visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he went to Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，有馴象自至京師。

translations.literal: On yisi, tame elephants came on their own to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi tame elephants appeared of their own accord in the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，幸節度使趙彥徽第視疾。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yimao, he visited military commissioner Zhao Yanhui's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on yimao, he called at the home of commissioner Zhao Yanhui, who lay ill.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，賜南唐米麥十萬斛。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dingwei, one hundred thousand hu of rice and wheat were granted to Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei, he sent Southern Tang a hundred thousand hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑朔，詔民田為霖雨、河水壞者，免今年夏稅及沿徵物。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on the guichou new-moon day, an edict: for commoners' fields damaged by prolonged rain and river flooding, this year's summer tax and accompanying levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the sixth month he remitted the summer tax and ancillary dues wherever fields had been ruined by rains and river floods.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔：荊蜀民祖父母、父母在者，子孫不得別財異居。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict: among Jing and Shu commoners, where grandparents and parents were alive, descendants might not split property and dwell apart.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he forbade the people of Jing and Shu to divide the household while parents or grandparents still lived.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Venus shone in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，復見。

translations.literal: On wuyin, it was seen again.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin it appeared again.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，龍出單父民家井中，大風雨，漂民舍四百區，死者數十人。

translations.literal: On xinsi, a dragon emerged from a commoner's well at Shanfu; great wind and rain floated away four hundred dwelling compounds; several tens died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi a dragon was reported from a well in Shanfu; a violent storm wrecked four hundred houses and killed dozens.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申，幸鐵騎營，賜軍錢羊酒有差。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingshen, he visited the Iron Cavalry Barracks and granted the army money, sheep, and wine in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on bingshen, he visited the Iron Cavalry and treated the troops to cash, mutton, and wine according to rank.

sentences.zh: 北漢穎州砦主胡遇等來降。

translations.literal: Northern Han Yingzhou Fort commander Hu Yu and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yu, commander of Northern Han's Yingzhou Fort, and others came over.

sentences.zh: 丙午，幸鐵騎營，遂幸玉津園。

translations.literal: On bingwu, he visited the Iron Cavalry Barracks, then visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he reviewed the Iron Cavalry, then rode on to Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 戊申，坊州刺史李懷節坐強市部民物，責左衛率府率。

translations.literal: On wushen, Fangzhou prefect Li Huaijie, for forcibly buying goods from tribesmen under his jurisdiction, was demoted to colonel of the Left Guard leading office.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Huaijie of Fangzhou was reduced to colonel of the Left Guard for extorting goods from tribal subjects.

sentences.zh: 北漢主劉鈞卒，養子繼恩立。

translations.literal: Northern Han ruler Liu Jun died; his adopted son Jiyin succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jun of Northern Han died, and his adopted son Jiyin took the throne.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，按鶻于近郊，還幸相國寺。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yimao, he flew hawks in the near suburbs, then returned to visit Xiangguo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yimao, he hawked near the city and stopped at Xiangguo Temple on his return.

sentences.zh: 戊午，又按鶻于北郊，還幸飛龍院。

translations.literal: On wuwu, again he flew hawks in the north suburbs, then returned to visit Flying Dragon Court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he hunted with hawks again in the northern suburbs, then called at Flying Dragon Court.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，遣客省使盧懷忠等二十二人率禁軍會潞州。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Reception Bureau envoy Lu Huaizhong and twenty-two others were dispatched to lead the palace guards to assemble at Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he sent Lu Huaizhong of the Reception Bureau and twenty-two colleagues with palace troops to rendezvous at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命昭義軍節度使李繼勳等征北漢。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Zhaoyi Army military commissioner Li Jixun and others were ordered to campaign against Northern Han.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Li Jixun, commissioner of Zhaoyi, and others were ordered to strike Northern Han.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳朔，禁錢出塞。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on the xinsi new-moon day, exporting coin beyond the border was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi new moon of the ninth month he barred copper cash from leaving the frontier.

sentences.zh: 癸未，監察御史楊士達坐鞠獄濫殺棄市。

translations.literal: On guiwei, investigating censor Yang Shida, for trying cases and killing excessively, was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei investigating censor Yang Shida was beheaded in the market for judicial murder.

sentences.zh: 庚子，李繼勳敗北漢於銅溫河。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Li Jixun defeated Northern Han at Tongwen River.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Jixun routed Northern Han at the Copper Warm River.

sentences.zh: 己酉，北漢供奉官侯霸榮弒其主繼恩，繼元立。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Northern Han palace attendant Hou Barong assassinated his lord Jiyin; Jiyuan succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Northern Han attendant Hou Barong murdered his sovereign Jiyin, and Jiyuan seized the throne.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己未，畋近郊，還幸飛龍院。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiwei, he hunted near the suburbs, then returned to visit Flying Dragon Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on jiwei, he hunted outside the walls and returned to Flying Dragon Court.

sentences.zh: 丙子，吳越王遣其子惟濬來朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the king of Wu-Yue sent his son Weijun to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the king of Wu-Yue sent his son Weijun to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，日南至，有事南郊，改元開寶。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on guimao, the winter solstice; the southern suburb rites were performed, and the reign title was changed to Kaibao.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the winter solstice of the eleventh month, he offered at the southern altar and proclaimed the Kaibao era.

sentences.zh: 大赦，十惡、殺人、官吏受贓者不原。

translations.literal: A grand amnesty; the ten abominations, homicide, and officials taking bribes were not pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty, except for the ten capital crimes, murder, and official corruption.

sentences.zh: 宰相普等奉玉冊、寶，上尊號曰應天廣運大聖神武明道至德仁孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Chancellor Pu and others presented the jade book and seal and offered the honorific title Emperor Responding to Heaven, Broad in Fortune, Great in Sageliness, Divine in Martial Power, Illumined in the Way, Ultimate in Virtue, and Filial in Benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Zhao Pu and his colleagues presented the jade register and seal, raising his title to Emperor Responding to Heaven, Broad in Fortune, Great in Sageliness, Divine in Martial Power, Illumined in the Way, Supreme in Virtue, and Filial in Benevolence.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，行慶，自開封興元尹、宰相、樞密使及諸道蕃侯，並加勳爵有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiazi, celebratory rewards were issued; from the Kaifeng and Xingyuan prefects, chancellors, and Bureau of Military Affairs commissioners to the various circuits' border marquises, all had honors and noble ranks added by grades.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he distributed victory honors, advancing the Kaifeng and Xingyuan prefects, the chancellors, the Bureau of Military Affairs chiefs, and frontier lords in rank and title by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大食國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On yichou, the Dashi state dispatched envoys to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou envoys from the Arab lands arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己卯朔，以出師，不御殿。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, on the jimao new-moon day, because the army had gone forth he did not preside in the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon in the second year of spring he withheld court audience while troops were in the field.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，命昭義軍節度使李繼勳為河東行營前軍都部署，侍衛步軍指揮使党進副之，宣徽南院使曹彬為都監，棣州防禦使何繼筠為石嶺關部署，建雄軍節度使趙贊為汾州路部署，以伐北漢。

translations.literal: Second month, on yimao, Zhaoyi Army military commissioner Li Jixun was appointed overall deployment of the vanguard for the Hedong campaign headquarters, Palace Guards infantry commander Dang Jin as his deputy, Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat commissioner Cao Bin as overall supervisor, Dizhou defense commissioner He Jiyun as Shiling Pass deployment, Jianxiong Army military commissioner Zhao Zan as Fenzhou route deployment, to campaign against Northern Han.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao of the second month he named Li Jixun of Zhaoyi overall commander of the Hedong field army's vanguard, with Palace Guards infantry commander Dang Jin as his deputy, Cao Bin of the Southern Palace Secretariat as chief supervisor, He Jiyun of Dizhou to hold Shiling Pass, and Zhao Zan of Jianxiong to command the Fenzhou route—all to wage war on Northern Han.

sentences.zh: 宴長春殿。

translations.literal: A feast was held in Changchun Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He gave a banquet in the Hall of Eternal Spring.

sentences.zh: 命彰德軍節度使韓仲贇為北面都部署，彰義軍節度使郭延義副之，以防契丹。

translations.literal: Zhande Army military commissioner Han Zhongyun was appointed northern overall deployment, Zhangyi Army military commissioner Guo Yanyi as deputy, to guard against the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhongyun of Zhande was made northern frontier commander with Guo Yanyi of Zhangyi as his deputy to watch the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔親征。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict ordered the emperor's personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he decreed that he would take the field in person.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以開封尹光義為上都留守，樞密副使沈義倫為大內部署、判留司三司事。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Kaifeng prefect Kuangyi was made acting prefect of the upper capital, Bureau of Military Affairs vice commissioner Shen Yilun was made inner-palace deployment and acting head of the capital agencies of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he left Kuangyi as Kaifeng prefect in charge of the upper capital and appointed Shen Yilun, vice commissioner of Military Affairs, to guard the palace and run the capital's Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 甲子，發京師。

translations.literal: On jiazi, he set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the emperor marched out from Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，雨，駐潞州。

translations.literal: On yihai, it rained; he halted at Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Rain on yihai forced a halt at Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，發潞州。

translations.literal: Third month, on renchen, he set out from Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen, he advanced from Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，李繼勳敗北漢軍於太原城下。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Li Jixun defeated the Northern Han army below Taiyuan city.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Li Jixun routed the Northern Han army under the walls of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，駕傅城下。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the imperial carriage arrived close below the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the emperor's train drew up beneath the walls.

sentences.zh: 庚子，觀兵城南，築長連城。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he reviewed troops south of the city and built a long linked wall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he inspected the army south of Taiyuan and began a chain of linked fortifications.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，幸汾河，作新橋。

translations.literal: On xinchou, he visited the Fen River and built a new bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he went to the Fen and threw a new bridge across it.

sentences.zh: 發太原諸縣丁數萬集城下。

translations.literal: Corvée laborers numbering in the tens of thousands were mobilized from the various counties around Taiyuan and assembled below the city.
translations.idiomatic: Tens of thousands of corvée laborers from the Taiyuan counties were drafted to the siege lines.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，北漢史昭文以憲州來降。

translations.literal: On guimao, Northern Han's Shi Zhaowen brought Xian Prefecture and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Shi Zhaowen of Northern Han surrendered Xianzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，臨城南，謂汾水可以灌其城，命築長隄壅之，決晉祠水注之。

translations.literal: On yisi, facing south of the city, he said the Fen waters could flood the city, ordered a long dike built to block it, and opened the Jin Shrine waters to pour in.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, viewing the southern walls, he judged the Fen could flood the city and ordered a dam built to divert it, cutting the Jin Shrine channel to pour water against Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 遂砦城四面，繼勳軍於南，贊軍於西，彬軍於北，進軍於東，乃北引汾水灌城。

translations.literal: Thereupon camps were placed on all four sides of the city: Jixun's army in the south, Zan's in the west, Bin's in the north, Jin's in the east; then the Fen was led north to flood the city.
translations.idiomatic: He ringed the city with camps—Jixun to the south, Zan to the west, Bin to the north, Jin to the east—then turned the Fen north to inundate the walls.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遣海州刺史孫方進率兵圍汾州。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Haizhou prefect Sun Fangjin was dispatched to lead troops and besiege Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Sun Fangjin of Haizhou was sent to invest Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 四月戊申，幸城東觀築隄。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on wushen, he visited the east of the city to observe dike construction.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wushen, he rode east of the city to watch the dikes go up.

sentences.zh: 壬子，復幸城東。

translations.literal: On renzi, again he visited the east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he returned to the eastern works.

sentences.zh: 己未，何繼筠敗契丹於陽曲，斬首數千級，俘武州刺史王彥符以獻，命陳示所獲首級、鎧甲於城下。

translations.literal: On jiwei, He Jiyun defeated the Khitan at Yangqu, cut off several thousand heads, captured Wuzhou prefect Wang Yanfu and presented him; he ordered the captured heads and armor displayed below the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei He Jiyun smashed the Khitan at Yangqu, taking thousands of heads and capturing Wuzhou prefect Wang Yanfu; the emperor had the trophies paraded before the walls.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幸汾河觀造船。

translations.literal: On renxu, he visited the Fen River to observe shipbuilding.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he went to the Fen to watch the fleet being built.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，幸城西上生院。

translations.literal: On wuchen, he visited the Upper Birth Courtyard west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he called at the Birth-Giving Abbey west of the city.

sentences.zh: 丙子，復幸城西。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he again visited the west of the city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he again went to the west of the city.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，韓仲贇敗契丹於定州北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guiwei, Han Zhongyun defeated the Khitan north of Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiwei, Han Zhongyun routed the Khitan north of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 自戊子至庚寅，命水軍載弩環攻，橫州團練使王廷義、殿前都虞候石漢卿死之。

translations.literal: From wuzi through gengyin he ordered the navy to load crossbows and attack in a ring; Hengzhou regimental commissioner Wang Tingyi and Palace Front chief inspector Shi Hanqing died in the action.
translations.idiomatic: From wuzi through gengyin he had the fleet mount crossbows and press the assault from every side; Wang Tingyi, regimental commissioner of Hengzhou, and Shi Hanqing, chief inspector of the Palace Front, were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，北漢趙文度以嵐州來降。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Northern Han Zhao Wendu surrendered Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhao Wendu of Northern Han came over with Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，都虞候趙廷翰奏，諸軍欲登城以死攻，上愍之，不允。

translations.literal: On jiachen, chief inspector Zhao Tinghan memorialized that the armies wished to scale the walls and storm to the death; the emperor pitied them and did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen chief inspector Zhao Tinghan reported that the troops wanted to storm the walls at all costs; the emperor, moved to pity, refused.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊申，雉圮，水注城中，上遽登隄觀。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on wushen, the parapet collapsed and water poured into the city; the emperor hurried up the dike to look.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wushen, the battlements gave way and floodwater rushed into the city; he climbed the embankment at once to see.

sentences.zh: 己酉，右僕射魏仁浦薨。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Right Vice Director Wei Renpu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Right Vice Director Wei Renpu died.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以太常博士李光贊言，議班師。

translations.literal: On renzi, on the advice of Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Li Guangzan, withdrawal was debated.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, at the urging of Li Guangzan, erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, the court debated pulling the army back.

sentences.zh: 己未，命兵士遷河東民萬戶于山東。

translations.literal: On jiwei he ordered soldiers to relocate ten thousand households of Hedong commoners to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he ordered troops to move ten thousand Hedong households east of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 庚申，分命使臣率兵赴鎮、潞。

translations.literal: On gengshen he separately dispatched envoys to lead troops to Zhen and Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he sent envoys in separate parties to lead troops to Zhen and Lu.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，駕還。

translations.literal: On renxu, the imperial carriage returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the emperor turned homeward.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，駐蹕於鎮州。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the court halted at Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the court encamped at Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子朔，發鎮州。

translations.literal: On the bingzi new moon of the sixth month, he set out from Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the bingzi new moon in the sixth month he marched from Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，至自太原。

translations.literal: On guisi, he returned from Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he came back from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 曲赦京城囚。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a limited amnesty for capital prisoners.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，幸封禪寺。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingsi, he visited Fengchan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month on dingsi, he visited Fengchan Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔鎮、深、趙、邢、洺五州管內鎮、砦、縣悉城之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that within the five prefectures of Zhen, Shen, Zhao, Xing, and Ming all forts, stockades, and counties were to be walled.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that every fort, stockade, and county in Zhen, Shen, Zhao, Xing, and Ming was to be walled.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大宴。

translations.literal: On jiazi, a great banquet was held.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he held a great feast.

sentences.zh: 賜宰相、樞密使、翰林學士、節度、觀察使襲衣金帶。

translations.literal: Chancellors, commissioners of military affairs, Hanlin academicians, and military governors and observation commissioners were granted court robes with gold belts.
translations.idiomatic: He bestowed court robes and gold belts on chancellors, commissioners of military affairs, Hanlin academicians, and military governors and observation commissioners.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，西南夷順化王子武才等來獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Prince Wucai of the Shunhua southwestern tribes and others came to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Prince Wucai of the southwestern Shunhua tribes and others arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，幸新水磑。

translations.literal: On guiyou, he visited the new water mill.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he inspected the new water mill.

sentences.zh: 汴決下邑。

translations.literal: The Bian River broke its banks at Xiayi.
translations.idiomatic: The Bian broke through at Xiayi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，壽星見。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Longevity Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Longevity Star was seen.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，詔川峽諸州察民有父母在而別籍異財者，論死。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict ordered that in the Chuan and Xia circuits officials were to investigate commoners who, though their parents lived, kept separate registers and divided property; such persons were to be sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict required officials in the Sichuan circuits to hunt out people who held separate household registers and split family property while their parents still lived; the penalty was death.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳朔，幸武成王廟。

translations.literal: On the yisi new moon of the ninth month, he visited the Temple of the Martial King.
translations.idiomatic: At the yisi new moon in the ninth month he visited the Temple of the Martial King.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On renxu, he visited Jade Ford Garden for a banquet and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he feasted and shot at Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，畋近郊。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuzi, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month on wuzi, he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，散指揮都知杜延進等謀反伏誅，夷其族。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Command director Du Yanjin and others, having plotted rebellion, were executed, and their clans were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Du Yanjin, director of the Command, and others were executed for treason, and their families were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 詔：相、深、趙三州丁夫死太原城下者，復其家。

translations.literal: An edict: for corvée laborers of the three prefectures of Xiang, Shen, and Zhao who died beneath the walls of Taiyuan, their households were restored.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored the households of corvée laborers from Xiang, Shen, and Zhao who had died under the walls of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以王溥為太子太師，武衡德為太子太傅。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Wang Pu was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and Wu Hengde was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Wang Pu was appointed grand preceptor of the heir apparent and Wu Hengde grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，西川兵馬都監張延通、內臣張嶼、引進副使王玨為丁德裕所譖，延通坐不遜誅，嶼、玨並杖配。

translations.literal: On guimao, Western Sichuan army-and-horse overseer Zhang Yantong, palace eunuch Zhang Yu, and deputy introduction commissioner Wang Jue were slandered by Ding Deyu; Yantong was executed for insubordination, and Yu and Jue were beaten and banished.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Zhang Yantong, overseer of army and horse in western Sichuan, the eunuch Zhang Yu, and deputy introduction commissioner Wang Jue were framed by Ding Deyu; Yantong was beheaded for insubordination, while Yu and Jue were flogged and exiled.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，幸鎮寧軍節度使張令鐸第視疾。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingwu, he visited the home of Zhenning military commissioner Zhang Lingduo to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingwu, he called at the house of Zhang Lingduo, military commissioner of Zhenning, to see him in his sickness.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，畋近郊，還幸金鳳園。

translations.literal: On jiayin, he hunted near the suburbs, then visited Golden Phoenix Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he hunted near the capital, then went on to Golden Phoenix Garden.

sentences.zh: 庚申，回鶻、于闐遣使來獻方物。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the Uyghurs of Ganzhou and Khotan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen envoys from the Ganzhou Uyghurs and Khotan came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，幸中書視宰相趙普疾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on guiwei, he visited the Secretariat to inquire after Chancellor Zhao Pu's illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiwei, he went to the Secretariat to see Chancellor Zhao Pu in his illness.

sentences.zh: 己亥，右贊善大夫王昭坐監大盈倉，其子與倉吏為姦贓，奪兩任、配隸汝州。

translations.literal: On jihai, Right Assistant in the Heir Apparent's Household Wang Zhao was punished for supervising the Great Abundance Granary while his son and granary clerks committed corrupt theft; he was stripped of two appointments and banished to Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Wang Zhao, right assistant in the heir apparent's household, was demoted for overseeing the Great Abundance Granary while his son and clerks stole; he lost two ranks and was sent to Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁德裕誣奏西川轉運使李鉉指斥，事既直，猶坐酒失，責授右贊善大夫。

translations.literal: Ding Deyu falsely memorialized that Western Sichuan transport commissioner Li Xuan had spoken contemptuously; though the charge was disproved, he was still punished for a wine offense and demoted to right assistant in the heir apparent's household.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Deyu accused Western Sichuan transport commissioner Li Xuan of slander; though Li was cleared, he was still punished for drunken misconduct and reduced to right assistant in the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸卯朔，雨雪，不御殿。

translations.literal: In year three, spring, first month, on the guimao new moon, snow and rain fell, and he did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In Kai Bao year three, on the guimao new moon in the first month of spring, snow fell and he withheld court audience.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，增河隄。

translations.literal: On guichou, the Yellow River embankments were strengthened.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou work to heighten the Yellow River dikes began.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔：民五千戶舉孝弟彰聞、德行純茂者一人，奇才異行不拘此限，里閭郡國遞審連署以聞，仍為治裝詣闕。

translations.literal: An edict: for every five thousand households, one man noted for filial piety and fraternal duty and for fame in conduct and pure virtue was to be chosen; men of extraordinary talent and unusual conduct were not bound by this limit. Local communities and commanderies and prefectures were to examine them in succession, affix seals in chain, and report upward; traveling expenses to court were also to be provided.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for each five-thousand-household district to nominate one man renowned for filial piety and pure conduct, with exceptional talent exempt from the quota. Communities, prefectures, and circuits were to vet candidates in turn, certify them jointly, and send them to court at public expense.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，幸西茶庫，遂幸建隆觀。

translations.literal: In the second month, on gengyin, he visited the West Tea Storehouse, then visited Jianlong Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengyin, he toured the West Tea Storehouse and went on to Jianlong Temple.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，詔閱進士十五舉以上司馬浦等百六人，並賜本科出身。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict ordered the examination of one hundred six men including Sima Pu, who had passed the jinshi examination fifteen times or more; all were granted status as jinshi of the present cohort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he examined one hundred six candidates, including Sima Pu, who had sat for the jinshi examination at least fifteen times, and granted them all jinshi of the current class.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜處士王昭素國子博士致仕。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the reclusive scholar Wang Zhaosu was granted the title of erudite of the Directorate of Education and retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the recluse Wang Zhaosu was made an erudite of the Directorate of Education and allowed to retire.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，殿中丞張顒坐先知潁州政不平，免官。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Palace Administration aide Zhang Yong was removed from office for having known in advance of irregular governance in Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Zhang Yong, aide in the Palace Administration, was dismissed for foreknowledge of misconduct in Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 己未，幸宰相趙普第視疾。

translations.literal: On jiwei, he visited Chancellor Zhao Pu's home to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he called at Chancellor Zhao Pu's house to see him in his sickness.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the xinwei new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, at the xinwei new moon of the fourth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On dinghai, he visited temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he went to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，雨。

translations.literal: On xinmao, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao rain came.

sentences.zh: 甲午，幸教船池。

translations.literal: On jiawu, he visited the naval training pool.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he inspected the naval training pool.

sentences.zh: 己亥，罷河北諸州鹽禁。

translations.literal: On jihai, the salt monopoly in Hebei prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he lifted the salt monopoly in the Hebei prefectures.

sentences.zh: 詔郡國非其土產者勿貢。

translations.literal: An edict: commanderies and prefectures were not to present tribute of products not native to their soil.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that circuits and prefectures must not send tribute goods that were not native to their regions.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，禁京城民畜兵器。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingwei, the capital populace was forbidden to keep weapons.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei, private arms were banned in the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幸城北觀水磑。

translations.literal: On guichou, he visited the northern suburbs to view the water mill.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he went north of the city to see the water mill.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賜諸班營舍為雨壞者錢有差。

translations.literal: On guihai, money was granted in varying amounts to the various guard barracks whose quarters rain had damaged.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he paid varying sums to guard units whose barracks the rains had ruined.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，禁諸州長吏親隨人掌廂鎮局務。

translations.literal: On yique, prefectural chief administrators were forbidden to let personal attendants control bureau and market offices in the stockade towns.
translations.idiomatic: On yique he barred prefects from letting private followers run stockade bureaus and market monopolies.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，立報水旱期式。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on yisi, a fixed schedule for reporting floods and droughts was established.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month on yisi, he set a regular form for reporting floods and droughts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔蜀州縣官以戶口差第省員加祿，尋詔諸路亦如之。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict ordered that Sichuan prefectural and county officials, ranked by household registers, should have their posts reduced or enlarged and salaries adjusted; soon an edict extended the same rule to all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he ordered Sichuan officials graded by household registers so that posts and salaries could be trimmed or increased; shortly afterward the rule was applied to every circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，幸教船池，又幸玉津園宴射。

translations.literal: On wuchen, he visited the naval training pool, then again visited Jade Ford Garden for a banquet and archery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he inspected the naval training pool, then feasted and shot at Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，幸教船池，又幸玉津園。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuzi, he visited the naval training pool, then again visited Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuzi, he went to the naval training pool and then to Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥朔，命潭州防禦使潘美為賀州道兵馬行營都部署，朗州團練使尹崇珂副之。

translations.literal: On the jihai new moon of the ninth month, Tanzhou defense commissioner Pan Mei was made overall commander of the Hezhou route army and horse, with Langzhou regimental commissioner Yin Chongke as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: At the jihai new moon in the ninth month Pan Mei, defense commissioner of Tan, was made overall commander of the Hezhou expedition, with Yin Chongke, regimental commissioner of Lang, as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 遣使發十州兵會賀州，以伐南漢。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to mobilize troops from ten prefectures to assemble at Hezhou to attack Southern Han.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to raise troops from ten prefectures at Hezhou for the campaign against Southern Han.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔︰西京、鳳翔、雄、耀等州，周文、成、康三王，秦始皇，漢高、文、景、武、元、成、哀七帝，後魏孝文，西魏文帝，後周太祖，唐高祖、太宗、中宗、肅宗、代宗、德、順、文、武、宣、懿、僖、昭諸帝凡二十七陵嘗被盜發者，有司備法服、常服各一襲，具棺槨重葬，所在長吏致祭。

translations.literal: An edict: for the twenty-seven imperial tombs at Xijing, Fengxiang, Xiong, Yao, and other prefectures—of the three Zhou kings Wen, Cheng, and Kang; Qin Shihuang; the seven Han emperors Gao, Wen, Jing, Wu, Yuan, Cheng, and Ai; Northern Wei Emperor Xiaowen; Western Wei Emperor Wendi; Later Zhou Taizu; and the Tang emperors Gaozu, Taizong, Zhongzong, Suzong, Daizong, Dezong, Shunzong, Wenzong, Wuzong, Xuanzong, Yizong, Xizong, and Zhaozong—that had been opened by grave robbers, the relevant offices were to prepare one set each of ceremonial and ordinary robes, provide coffins for reburial, and have the local chief officials offer sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed reburial for twenty-seven violated imperial tombs in the west—ranging from the Zhou kings Wen, Cheng, and Kang and Qin Shihuang through seven Han emperors, Northern Wei Xiaowen, Western Wei Wendi, Later Zhou Taizu, and fifteen Tang rulers. Each site was to receive fresh ceremonial and everyday robes, new coffins, and sacrifices from the local magistrate.

sentences.zh: 己酉，幸開寶寺觀新鐘。

translations.literal: On jiyou, he visited Kai Bao Temple to view the new bell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he went to Kai Bao Temple to see the new bell.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，女直國遣使齎定安國王烈萬華表，獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingchen, the Jurchen state sent envoys bearing the memorial table of King Liewanhua of Ding'an, presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Jurchen envoys arrived with the memorial of King Liewanhua of Ding'an and tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，潘美等敗南漢軍萬眾於富州，下之。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Pan Mei and others defeated more than ten thousand Southern Han troops at Fuzhou and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Pan Mei and his colleagues routed more than ten thousand Southern Han soldiers at Fuzhou and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 十月庚辰，克賀州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on gengchen, Hezhou was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengchen, Hezhou fell.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，下昭、桂二州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renyin, Zhao and Gui prefectures were taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin, Zhao and Gui were captured.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，減桂陽歲貢白金額。

translations.literal: On yisi, the annual tribute quota of white gold from Guiyang was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he cut Guiyang's yearly white-gold tribute quota.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，右領軍衛將軍石延祚坐監倉與吏為姦贓，棄市。

translations.literal: On guichou, Right Vanguard Guard general Shi Yanzuo was executed in the market for supervising a granary while clerks committed corrupt theft.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Shi Yanzuo of the Right Vanguard Guard was beheaded for letting granary clerks steal under his oversight.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，定州駐泊都監田欽祚敗契丹於遂城。

translations.literal: On guihai, Dingzhou garrison commander Tian Qin'zuo defeated the Khitan at Suicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Tian Qin'zuo, garrison commander at Dingzhou, routed the Khitan at Suicheng.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以曹州舉德行孔蟾為章丘主簿。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Kong Chan of Caozhou, nominated for virtue, was made registrar of Zhangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Kong Chan of Cao, chosen for moral conduct, was appointed registrar of Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，潘美等下連州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renshen, Pan Mei and others took Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renshen, Pan Mei and his forces captured Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大敗南漢軍萬餘於韶州，下之。

translations.literal: On xinmao, they inflicted a great defeat on more than ten thousand Southern Han troops at Shaozhou and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao they smashed more than ten thousand Southern Han soldiers at Shaozhou and seized the city.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，增河隄。

translations.literal: On guisi, the Yellow River embankments were strengthened.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi work to heighten the Yellow River dikes resumed.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月戊戌朔，以出師，不視朝。

translations.literal: In year four, spring, first month, on the wuxu new moon, because the army had gone forth he did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: In Kai Bao year four, on the wuxu new moon in the first month of spring, he withheld court audience while the expedition was in the field.

sentences.zh: 丙午，罷諸道州縣攝官。

translations.literal: On bingwu, acting officials in prefectures and counties on all circuits were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he abolished temporary acting posts in prefectures and counties throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁未，右千牛衛大將軍桑進興坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Right Thousand-Ox Guard grand general Sang Jinxing was executed in the market for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Sang Jinxing, grand general of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard, was beheaded for graft.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，潘美等取英州、雄州。

translations.literal: On guichou, Pan Mei and others took Yingzhou and Xiongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Pan Mei and his colleagues captured Ying and Xiong.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，南漢劉鋹遣其左僕射蕭漼等以表來上。
