translations.literal: In the second month, on dinghai, Southern Han Liu Chang sent his Left Vice Director Xiao Huan and others to submit a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dinghai, Liu Chang of Southern Han sent his left vice director Xiao Huan and others with a surrender memorial.

sentences.zh: 己丑，潘美克廣州，俘劉鋹，廣南平。

translations.literal: On jichou, Pan Mei captured Guangzhou, took Liu Chang prisoner, and Guangnan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Pan Mei took Guangzhou, seized Liu Chang, and Guangnan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 得州六十、縣二百十四、戶十七萬二百六十三。

translations.literal: Sixty prefectures, two hundred fourteen counties, and one hundred seventy thousand two hundred sixty-three households were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The victory yielded sixty prefectures, two hundred fourteen counties, and 170,263 households.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大赦廣南，免二稅，偽署官仍舊。

translations.literal: On xinmao, a great amnesty was proclaimed for Guangnan, the two taxes were remitted, and puppet appointees kept their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he proclaimed a great amnesty for Guangnan, remitted the two principal taxes, and left former puppet officials in place.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未，幸飛龍院，賜從臣馬。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yique, he visited Flying Dragon Hall and bestowed horses on his attending ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yique, he went to Flying Dragon Hall and gave horses to the ministers in attendance.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔：廣南有賣人男女為奴婢轉傭利者，並放免；

translations.literal: On bingshen, an edict: in Guangnan those who sold men and women as slave servants for profit were all to be released;
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an edict declared that anyone in Guangnan who had sold men and women as slaves for profit must set them free;

sentences.zh: 偽政有害于民者具以聞，除之。

translations.literal: harmful measures of the puppet regime were to be reported in detail and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: and harmful policies of the old regime were to be reported so they could be abolished.

sentences.zh: 增前代帝王守陵戶二。

translations.literal: The households guarding former dynasties' imperial tombs were increased by two.
translations.idiomatic: He added two households to each guard community at the tombs of former emperors.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙寅朔，前左監門衛將軍趙玭訴宰相趙普，坐誣毀大臣，汝州安置。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the bingyin new moon, former Left Gate Guard general Zhao Pi accused Chancellor Zhao Pu and, for slandering a great minister, was settled at Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, at the bingyin new moon of the fourth month, former Left Gate Guard general Zhao Pi denounced Chancellor Zhao Pu and, for defaming a senior minister, was exiled to Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，三佛齊國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the Three Buddhas Polity sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao envoys from the Three Buddhas Polity arrived with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔禁嶺南商稅、鹽、麴，如荊湖法。

translations.literal: On jisi, an edict forbade commercial taxes, salt, and yeast in the Lingnan region, following the Jing and Hu model.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he banned Lingnan trade levies, salt, and yeast monopolies, applying the Jing-Hu rules.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸永興軍節度使吳廷祚第視疾。

translations.literal: On xinwei, he visited the home of Yongxing military commissioner Wu Tingzuo to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he called at the house of Wu Tingzuo, military commissioner of Yongxing, to see him in his sickness.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸開寶寺。

translations.literal: On guiwei, he visited Kai Bao Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he went to Kai Bao Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，南唐遣其弟從諫來朝貢。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Southern Tang sent the ruler's younger brother Congjian to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Southern Tang sent the ruler's brother Congjian to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 發廂軍千人修前代陵寢之在秦者。

translations.literal: A thousand men of the garrison corps were sent to repair the former dynasties' tombs located in Qin.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched a thousand garrison troops to restore the ancient imperial tombs in Qin.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，監察御史閭丘舜卿坐前任盜用官錢，棄市。

translations.literal: On renchen, investigating censor Lüqiu Shunqing was executed in the market for embezzling official funds in a former post.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen investigating censor Lüqiu Shunqing was beheaded for stealing public money in an earlier office.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未朔，御明德門受劉鋹俘，釋之；

translations.literal: On the yique new moon of the fifth month, he held court at Bright Virtue Gate to receive Liu Chang as a captive and released him;
translations.idiomatic: At the yique new moon in the fifth month he took audience at Bright Virtue Gate to receive Liu Chang as a prisoner, then set him free;

sentences.zh: 斬其柄臣龔澄樞、李托、薛崇譽。

translations.literal: his chief ministers Gong Chengsi, Li Tuo, and Xue Chongyu were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: and executed his chief ministers Gong Chengsi, Li Tuo, and Xue Chongyu.

sentences.zh: 大宴於大明殿，鋹預焉。

translations.literal: A great banquet was held in the Great Bright Hall, and Chang attended.
translations.idiomatic: He gave a great feast in the Great Bright Hall, and Chang was present.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，賞伐廣南功，潘美、尹崇珂等進爵有差。

translations.literal: On dingyou, merit in the Guangnan campaign was rewarded; Pan Mei, Yin Chongke, and others were advanced in noble rank in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he rewarded the Guangnan campaign; Pan Mei, Yin Chongke, and others were raised in noble rank according to merit.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，遣使祀南海。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guiyou, envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Southern Sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiyou, he sent envoys to offer sacrifice at the Southern Sea.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命翰林試南漢官，取書判稍優者，授令、錄、簿、尉。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Hanlin Academy tested Southern Han officials; those whose document judgments were somewhat superior were appointed magistrates, registrars, clerks, and constables.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Hanlin Academy examined former Southern Han officials and gave the better writers posts as magistrates, registrars, clerks, and constables.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以孝子羅居通為延州主簿。

translations.literal: On renwu, the filial son Luo Jutong was made registrar of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Luo Jutong, honored for filial piety, was appointed registrar of Yan.

sentences.zh: 封劉鋹為恩赦侯。

translations.literal: Liu Chang was enfeoffed as Marquis of Ensha.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chang was created Marquis of Ensha.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，罷賀州銀場。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the Hezhou silver field was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he closed the Hezhou silver works.

sentences.zh: 賜劉鋹月奉外錢五萬、米麥五千斛。

translations.literal: Liu Chang was granted, beyond his monthly stipend, fifty thousand in cash and five thousand hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond his monthly allowance, Liu Chang received fifty thousand cash and five thousand hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 河決原武，汴決穀熟。

translations.literal: The Yellow River broke its banks at Yuanwu, and the Bian broke its banks at Gushu.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst at Yuanwu and the Bian at Gushu.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，賜開封尹光義門戟十四。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on wuxu, Kaifeng chief Guangyi was granted fourteen gate halberds.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the seventh month on wuxu, he granted fourteen gate halberds to Kaifeng chief Guangyi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幸新修水磑，賜役人錢帛有差。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he visited the newly repaired water mill and bestowed money and silks on the laborers in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he inspected the rebuilt water mill and paid the workers money and silks according to rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，復著內侍養子令。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the ordinance on palace eunuchs adopting sons was reissued.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he restored the rules on palace eunuchs adopting sons.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，幸建武軍節度使何繼筠第視疾。

translations.literal: On guihai, he visited the home of Jianwu military commissioner He Jijun to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he called at the house of He Jijun, military commissioner of Jianwu, to see him in his sickness.

sentences.zh: 汴決宋城。

translations.literal: The Bian River broke its banks at Songcheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Bian broke through at Songcheng.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，文武百官上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renshen, civil and military officials presented a honorific title; he did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renshen, civil and military officials offered him a honorific title, which he declined.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，景星見。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an auspicious star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao an auspicious star was seen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the guihai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, at the guihai new moon of the tenth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔偽作黃金者棄市。

translations.literal: On jisi, an edict ordered that counterfeiters of gold be executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he decreed death for anyone who forged gold.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太子洗馬王元吉坐贓棄市。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Heir Apparent's Household groom Wang Yuanji was executed in the market for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Wang Yuanji, groom in the heir apparent's household, was beheaded for graft.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，除廣南舊無名配斂。

translations.literal: On xinsi, unauthorized levies formerly imposed in Guangnan were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he abolished illegal surcharges once collected in Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔十月後犯強竊盜者郊赦不原。

translations.literal: On jiashen, an edict: after the tenth month, those guilty of robbery with force or stealth would not be pardoned at suburban amnesties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he ruled that from the tenth month onward, violent or stealthy robbers would not be spared even at suburban amnesties.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，放廣南民驅充軍者。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Guangnan commoners who had been driven into military service were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he freed Guangnan civilians who had been pressed into the army.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳朔，南唐遣其弟從善，吳越國王遣其子惟濬，以郊祀來朝貢。

translations.literal: On the guisi new moon of the eleventh month, Southern Tang sent the ruler's younger brother Congshan, and the King of Wuyue sent his son Weijun, to court with tribute for the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: At the guisi new moon in the eleventh month Southern Tang sent the ruler's brother Congshan and Wuyue sent the king's son Weijun to court with tribute for the suburban rites.

sentences.zh: 南唐主煜表乞去國號呼名，從之。

translations.literal: Southern Tang ruler Yu memorialized, begging to drop his state name and be addressed by personal name; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang ruler Li Yu asked to abandon his state title and be called by his personal name alone; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔諸道所罷攝官三任無遺闕者以聞。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict ordered that acting officials abolished on the circuits who had served three terms without omission were to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he required circuits to report former acting officials who had completed three terms without fault.

sentences.zh: 河決澶州，通判姚恕坐不即上聞，棄市。

translations.literal: The Yellow River broke its banks at Chanzhou; Assistant Administrator Yao Shu, for not reporting at once, was executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst at Chan; Assistant Administrator Yao Shu was beheaded for failing to report it immediately.

sentences.zh: 己未，日南至，有事南郊，大赦，十惡、故劫殺、官吏受贓者不原。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the winter solstice arrived; the southern suburb rites were performed, a great amnesty was proclaimed, and the ten abominations, prior robbery-murder, and official bribery were not pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei came the winter solstice; he sacrificed at the southern suburb, proclaimed a great amnesty, and withheld mercy for the ten abominations, old cases of robbery-murder, and official bribery.

sentences.zh: 詔置諸州幕職官奉戶。

translations.literal: An edict established salary households for staff posts in the prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed salary households for prefectural staff offices.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，蜀班內殿直四十人，援御馬直例乞賞，遂撾登聞鼓，命各杖二十；

translations.literal: On renxu, forty men of the Sichuan detachment in the inner palace, citing the precedent of the Imperial Horse Guard, begged for rewards and beat the Denunciation Drum; each was ordered flogged twenty times;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu forty Sichuan guards in the inner palace, citing the Imperial Horse Guard precedent, demanded rewards and pounded the Denunciation Drum; each was ordered twenty strokes of the rod;

sentences.zh: 翌日，悉斬於營，都指揮單斌等皆杖、降。

translations.literal: the next day, all were beheaded in camp, and Command director Shan Bin and others were flogged and demoted.
translations.idiomatic: the next day they were all beheaded in camp, while Command director Shan Bin and others were flogged and reduced in rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥朔，賜南郊執事官器幣有差。

translations.literal: On the guihai new moon of the twelfth month, ritual vessels were bestowed on officials performing the southern suburb rites in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: At the guihai new moon in the twelfth month he granted ritual vessels to southern-suburb officials according to rank.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，行慶，開封尹光義、興元尹光美、貴州防禦使德昭、宰相趙普並益食邑。

translations.literal: On dingmao, celebratory gifts were distributed; Kaifeng chief Guangyi, Xingyuan chief Guangmei, Guizhou defense commissioner Dezhao, and Chancellor Zhao Pu all had their food fiefs increased.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he distributed celebration gifts, increasing the food fiefs of Guangyi of Kaifeng, Guangmei of Xingyuan, Dezhao of Gui, and Chancellor Zhao Pu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，內外文武官遞進勳爵。

translations.literal: On jisi, civil and military officials inside and outside the court were advanced in merit titles and noble ranks in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi officials at court and in the provinces were promoted in merit titles and noble ranks in turn.

sentences.zh: 辛未，賜九經李符本科出身。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Li Fu, master of the Nine Classics, was granted status as jinshi of the present cohort.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Fu, master of the Nine Classics, was made a jinshi of the current class.

sentences.zh: 壬午，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On renwu, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he hunted near the capital.
